changes.title: Wild look
items: New Wild look group on the pause page: her light's reach, brightness and colour in the wild, and a new colour grade that only shows in the wild (off at first)

changes.title: Sail takeoff freeze
items: Taking off from the treehouse should no longer freeze, after a sail or not: the house seen from the air and your sigil stack are now prepared ahead

changes.title: Sigil feel
items: A quick tap of the sigil button now puts down or picks up exactly one sigil; hold it a moment to start a run
Sigils flash in their own colour as they fly between the ground and her head, burn into the ground with a glow when put down, and sparkle above her head when picked up

changes.title: No crawl
items: Walking north or south, grass, flowers and trees no longer flicker a pixel back and forth
Which of two overlapping things is drawn on top no longer depends on where the camera is
